Every investigation brings the Ghost Adventures crew face-to-face with unsettling encounters, unexplained sounds and chilling moments. From eerie locations to unexpected paranormal activity, these investigations test the team's courage as they try to capture evidence of what may be lurking beyond the ordinary. But which encounters will prove to be the most intense, and what will the crew uncover?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 11, Episodes 13, 6, 3, 11, 4, 8 and 5, on Discovery Channel India.
